entityLinks.note: Holds the Iron-Vow muster yard at Cinderford Keep.
Runs the Ashen Flagon hearth inside the timber walls.
Leads the blind weavers above the black aqueduct.
Keeps hollow watch on the bronze plinth overlooking the Belfry.
Trades the Seal of Silence for the barrow Echo-Shell.
Carries his resonant bronze greatblade at the Crown-Gate.
Rests beside Sir Vorne's forgotten oath tablet in the inner crypt.
Sealed behind a Durnfolk counterweight chamber.
Locked in the deep armory behind the Basalt Kiln-Warden.
Guarded by the Corrupted Star-Stag in the Heart-Glade.
Hunts along the broken Imperial flagstones in embers and smoke.
Scorched hide often carries volatile ember-resin.
Rises wherever pale spores take root in damp earth.
Calcified spore sacs form inside hollow ribcages.
Spins acid silk across drainage flues and sunken vents.
Stragglers from the frontier levy extract road tolls by force.
Swings pale-root censers to amplify the Third Drowning Toll.
Ancient wood-spirit strangled by chiming pale vines.
Ancient basalt construct watching the abyssal sluice-valve.
Tests every traveler approaching the Sunken Belfry from above.
Prepares the Third Drowning Toll beneath the drowned bronze bell.
Dispatched if the sacred Vesper-Font is plundered.
What remains of the deserter Kale if left to hollow.
Holds the last standing palisade on the frontier.
Maintains the counter-harmonic looms beneath Ash-Fen.
Maintains a hidden black-ledger beneath Quartermaster Harken's stall.
Draws pale roots upward toward Day 14.

npcReactions.text: His hand shifts instinctively toward his sword hilt as he takes in the unnatural alterations upon your flesh.
His eyes linger on the scar across your face and the corded bulk of your shoulders, measuring a veteran.
He tilts his chin slightly to meet your towering height without yielding ground.
He frowns at your lean, hollow-cheeked frame as though doubting you could bear a pike.
His gaze catches the kiln-brand on your skin and narrows with grudging recognition.
Her blind gaze turns sharply toward the subtle arcane hum of your implanted flesh.
Her blind head cocks sharply as if hearing the defilement resonating beneath your skin.
Her fingers twitch at the faint smell of old kiln-burn upon your flesh.
She inclines her veiled face toward the ragged seam across your cheek, murmuring of iron debts.
The luminous cavern silk reflects softly off your pale skin.
She clucks softly at the gaunt hollows beneath your cheekbones and reaches for a fuller ladle.
She eyes your scars with the tired sympathy of a border innkeeper who has bandaged too many rangers.
His bronze bell-helm tilts as he weighs your heavy frame against his own.
Through the visor slit, his gaze rests on the old scars showing beneath your collar.
